feeds.title: Center for Feminist Foreign Policy
feeds.description: Latest news analyses and global perspectives from the CFFP. The Centre for Feminist Foreign Policy is a non-profit organization (gGmbH) based in Berlin and advocates for a feminist foreign policy that challenges the conventional standards of international politics.

feeds.title: GIZ Gender Week Blog
feeds.description: GIZ provides you with insights into our work and contributions to the promotion of equal rights and opportunities for all regardless of one's gender, sexual orientation and gender identity highlighted e.g. during GIZ's annual Gender Week and Competitions

feeds.title: International Women* Space
feeds.description: International Women* Space (IWS) is a feminist, anti-racist political group in Berlin with refugee and migrant women* and non-migrant women* as members. Dive into our newest blog articles for News stories, Activist interviews, and Perspectives on Women's movement and more.

feeds.title: Feminist Studies Blog
feeds.description: Dive deep into a captivating coverage of pressing Feminist and Gender concerns. The blog feministische studien is a supplementary resource to the Female Studies Journal, one of the important inter- and transdisciplinary journals for women's and gender studies in German-speaking countries. It features articles on current debates.

feeds.title: Antje Schrupp | For the love of Freedom
feeds.description: Antje Schrupp shares her thoughts and notes on the work of sexual difference. Read cutting pieces and dissection of Patriarchy, Existing systems, Feminist arguments on a range of topics, and more enlightening content.

feeds.title: Fair Share of Women Leaders
feeds.description: Stay refreshed on Feminist work across the globe with the latest Blogs, events, podcasts, interviews, and more compelling feminism-focused content brought to you by Fair Share of Women Leaders. The FAIR SHARE Action Circle is a group of six feminist leaders with strong competencies in women's rights, movement building, and advocacy.

feeds.title: PINKSTINKS
feeds.description: Immerse yourself in a wave of Feminism-focused news, and campaign articles, Gender, and other discourses. Pinkstinks is an educational organization on the topic of sexism. They criticize rigid gender roles and devaluation based on gender in media and advertising and show that things can be more diverse and beneficial for everyone.

feeds.title: Unbias The News
feeds.description: Unbias The News is a feminist cross-border newsroom that actively fights against the perpetuation of racist, sexist, and ableist stereotypes. Check out their stories delivering in-depth, balanced, and thought-provoking coverage of topics spanning environmental crises, Indigenous women's empowerment, female leadership, and sustainable practices worldwide.

feeds.title: Missy Magazine
feeds.description: Missy Magazine is a major publication representing independent, feminist journalism and features strong content about trans families, sex work, the shift to the right, coding, fat acceptance, compatibility, anal plugs, care work, rap, cats, menstruation in horror films, asylum and everyday life, armpit hair, and new series highlights.
